exercises.instructions: Choose the correct form of 'have' to complete each sentence.

questions.question: I ________ a car.
questions.explanation: With 'I', we use 'have'. 'I have' is the correct Simple Present form for first person singular. 'I' နဲ့ 'have' ကိုသုံးပါ။

questions.question: She ________ many pencils.
questions.explanation: With 'she', we use 'has'. 'Has' is the correct Simple Present form for third person singular. 'She' နဲ့ 'has' ကိုသုံးပါ။

questions.explanation: With 'we', we use 'have'. 'We have' is the correct Simple Present form for first person plural. 'We' နဲ့ 'have' ကိုသုံးပါ။

questions.question: I ________ a car before.
questions.explanation: 'Before' indicates past time, so we use 'had' (Simple Past). 'Before' ဆိုတာ အတိတ်ကာလဖြစ်တဲ့အတွက် 'had' ကိုသုံးပါ။

questions.question: ကျွန်မ ကားတစ်စီး ရှိတယ်။ (I / a car)
questions.explanation: Simple Present Affirmative: Subject + have. 'တယ်' indicates present affirmative. With 'I', we use 'have'. Simple Present အတည်ပြုပုံ - Subject + have။

questions.question: အရင်က ကျွန်မ ကားတစ်စီး ရှိခဲ့တယ်။ (I / a car / before)
options: I will have a car before.
questions.explanation: Simple Past Affirmative: Subject + had. 'ခဲ့တယ်' indicates past. 'Before' indicates past time. Simple Past အတည်ပြုပုံ - Subject + had။

options: I will have a car next year.
I have a car next year.
I had a car next year.
questions.answer: I will have a car next year.
questions.explanation: Simple Future Affirmative: Subject + will have. 'မယ်' and 'next year' indicate future. Simple Future အတည်ပြုပုံ - Subject + will have။

questions.explanation: Simple Present Affirmative: Subject + have. 'တယ်' indicates present affirmative. With 'we', we use 'have'. Simple Present အတည်ပြုပုံ - Subject + have။

questions.question: သူ ကား မရှိဘူး။ (He / a car)

She have been here for twenty minutes.
She had been here for twenty minutes.
questions.answer: She has been here for twenty minutes.
questions.explanation: Present Perfect: Subject + has + V3. 'ကတည်းက' indicates an action that started in the past and continues to the present. With 'she', we use 'has'. Present Perfect - Subject + has + V3။

We will have met him before he became famous.
questions.answer: We had met him before he became famous.
questions.explanation: Past Perfect: Subject + had + V3. 'ပြီ' and 'before he became famous' indicate an action completed before another past action. Past Perfect - Subject + had + V3။

questions.question: သူ ကွန်ပျူတာ ပျက်ခင် စာရွက်ကို ကူးယူပြီးပြီ။ (Tom / copied / before the computer crashed)

Tom has copied his document before the computer crashed.
Tom will have copied his document before the computer crashed.
questions.answer: Tom had copied his document before the computer crashed.
questions.explanation: Past Perfect: Subject + had + V3. 'ပြီးပြီ' and 'before the computer crashed' indicate an action completed before another past action. Past Perfect - Subject + had + V3။

questions.question: ငါတို့ ဒီစီမံကိန်းကို ပြီးအောင်လုပ်ပြီးမယ်။ (We / finished / our project)
options: We will have finished our project.

questions.question: သူ ပါတီမတိုင်ခင် သူမကို တွေ့ပြီးပြီလား။ (Had / he / met her / before the party)
options: Had he met her before the party?
Did he meet her before the party?
Has he met her before the party?
questions.answer: Had he met her before the party?
questions.explanation: Past Perfect Interrogative: Had + subject + V3? 'လား' indicates a question. 'Before the party' indicates past time before another past action. Past Perfect မေးခွန်းပုံ - Had + subject + V3?

questions.question: သူ အရင်က သူ့ကို မြင်ဖူးတယ်။ (I / seen him / before)
